IS 1559 : Part 2 : 2025 Methods of Chemical Analysis of Ferrosilicon - Part 2 Determination of Carbon
ICS 77.100
ICS 77.100
MTD 34
MTD 34
Revised Standard from Last Update.
1 SCOPE
This standard (Part 2) covers the determination of carbon (0.15 percent to 1.50 percent) in ferrosilicon.
2 REFERENCES
The standards given below contain provisions, which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of these standards:
IS 266 : 2024
Sulphuric acid - Specification (fourth revision)
IS 1070 : 2023
Reagent grade water - Specification (fourth revision)
IS 1472 : 1977
Methods for sampling ferro-alloys for determination of chemical composition (first revision)
IS 6226 (Part 1) : 2025
Recommendations of apparatus for chemical analysis of metals: Part 1 Apparatus for determination of carbon by direct combustion (second revision)
